name: Basin
overview: The biblical references to basins reveal their use as important vessels in the worship and service of God, crafted from valuable materials such as brass (bronze) and gold. In Exodus, basins are described as part of the altar's utensils, all made of brass, underscoring their role in the sacrificial system. Ezra highlights basins made of gold and silver, indicating their preciousness and significance in the temple context. These details emphasize the careful design and material value given to basins, reflecting their sacred function in God's ordained worship.
